arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS mastercard_credit_transactions_over_500 FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.card_brand = 'Mastercard' AND c.card_type = 'Credit' AND t.amount_usd_cents > 50000
arguments.explanation: Counts the Mastercard credit card transactions whose amount is over $500.
assumptions: 'Over $500' means amount_usd_cents strictly greater than 50000 (exactly $500.00 is excluded).
Counts all such transactions, labelled or not, matching the earlier count's scope.
Covers the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
